Method of Attack: Deploys a backdoor malware that hides configuration files on victim's disk to evade detection
Exploits Microsoft Exchange remote code execution vulnerability CVE-2021-26855 for initial access
Uses batch scripts to deploy configuration files named config.txt, node.txt, and error.txt
Creates a service upon launch with encrypted C2 server addresses and communicates via port 80
Executes commands from C2, downloads and runs files, updates configuration, and can uninstall itself
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Microsoft Exchange vulnerability CVE-2021-26855
Use of malicious batch scripts to deploy backdoor and configuration files
Indicators of Compromise: Configuration files named config.txt, node.txt, error.txt
Use of port 80 for C2 communication
Batch files dropping configuration files on host
Encrypted C2 server addresses in configuration file
